verdicts.rationale: All four members share DOI 10.1111/nous.12404, title 'The Structure of Analog Representation', identical authors (Lee, Myers, Rabin), Noûs 57(1), pp. 209-237. lee2022structure is tagged 'Preprint (forthcoming)' but carries the same DOI/pages — preprint vs published of one work. The two deepIndexed members (lee2023structure, lee2022structure) are the same work.
Both members share DOI 10.5840/protosociology2014318, title, authors (Lepore & Stone), ProtoSociology vol 31, pp. 75-87. Loser is a hand/Zotero key variant with no indexing. Same work.

Both 'Imagination and Convention' by Lepore and Stone, OUP, identical ISBN 9780198797418. Year differs (2014 vs 2015 printing) but it is the same book. Neither is indexed; only survivor has a folder. Same work.
Both share DOI 10.1002/wcs.1436, title 'Bridging views in cinema', authors Levin & Baker, WIREs Cognitive Science 8(5). Loser is an unindexed Zotero-style key. Same work.

lewis1970general, cambridge1970general, and lewis1972general all share DOI 10.1007/bf00413598, Synthese 22(1-2), pp. 18-67 — the same journal article. lewis1972semantics is a distinct publication: different DOI (10.1007/978-94-010-2557-7_7), an incollection in 'Semantics of Natural Language' (Springer Netherlands), year 1972, pp. 169-218 — the reprinted book-chapter version, not the same bibliographic item. It is unindexed so no real work is lost, but it should not be folded into the journal-article entry.
Both 'Counterfactuals' by David K. Lewis, 1973 — the two simultaneous co-editions (Blackwell UK / Harvard University Press US). Same book. Only survivor is deepIndexed. Same work.
Both share DOI 10.1111/nous.12085, title 'Elusive Counterfactuals', author Karen S. Lewis, Noûs 50(2), pp. 286-313. Year differs (2015 vs 2016 print/online) but same DOI. Same work.
All three share DOI 10.1111/nous.12194, title 'Counterfactual Discourse in Context', author Karen S. Lewis, Noûs 52(3), pp. 481-507. Losers are key/year variants. Same work.
Both members are field-identical: DOI 10.1007/s44204-025-00288-6, 'Mnemic scenarios as pictures', Liefke, Asian Journal of Philosophy 4(2). Loser is an unindexed Zotero-style key. Same work.
Both members are field-identical: DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-74859-2_22, 'Enhancement of Spatial Cognition in Deaf Children', same author list and pages. Duplicate import. Same work.
Both share DOI 10.1073/pnas.0910981106, 'World Color Survey color naming...', Lindsey & Brown, PNAS 106(47), pp. 19785-19790. Loser is an unindexed Zotero-style key. Same work.

The survivor lopes2004understanding ('Understanding Pictures', 2004, chapter-level OUP DOI) and lopes1996understanding ('Understanding pictures', 1996, Clarendon Press, ISBN 9780198240976) are different editions/publications of Dominic Lopes' book. BOTH members are independently deepIndexed with folders, so merging would archive real indexed work. Per the two-plus-indexed rule, keep the 1996 edition separate.
